newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Van Der Horst falls 11.5 pct at close.
newsitem.headline: Van Der Horst falls 11.5 pct at close.

text.p: Engineering based Van Der Horst Ltd (VDH) shares slumped 11.5 percent or Singapore $0.65 to end at S$5.00 just before the close on Thursday.
Volume was over a million shares.
Analysts said they could give no reason for the sharp drop in the share price except that one of the company's directors had sold off his entire stake recently.
Feddie Heng, executive director of VDH, sold one million VDH shares at S$5.793 and 400,000 VDH warrants at S$4.70 on February 28.
After the sale, Heng has no shares left in the company.
"We heard that he sold for personal reasons. But it is not a good sign if a director sells all his shares," said an analyst with a foreign broking house.
VDH officials were not immediately available for comment.
